sentences.text:
Avanish Kumar Singh And 3 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others
on 1 October, 2024

Author: Siddhartha Varma
Bench: Siddhartha Varma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:160223-Db
Court No. - 45
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 17767 of 2024
Petitioner :- Avanish Kumar Singh And 3 Others
Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Dinesh Kumar Singh,Pawan Kumar Rao

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddhartha Varma,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned AGA for the State-respondents.
2. Although prayer made in this writ petition is to quash the First Information Report dated 18.08.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 220 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 of IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station - Sarai Inayat, District - Prayagraj but at the time when the matter is taken up learned counsel for the petitioners confines his relief to grant of protection under section 41-A of Code of Criminal Procedure.

entities.text: Police Station - Sarai Inayat, District - Prayagraj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Kumar Singh And 3 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65318253/
1 3.

entities.text: Kumar Singh And 3 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
We have perused the the First Information Report which prima facie discloses cognizable offence and, therefore, the prayer made to quash F.I.R. otherwise cannot be entertained in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani, (2017)
2 SCC 779 and Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others, (2021) SCC Online SC 315.
4.

entities.text:
State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani, (2017)
2 SCC 779
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others, (2021) SCC Online SC 315
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We are of the view that no interference is warranted.

5. However, considering the fact that all offences, mentioned in the present, are punisable with a term up to 7 years, therefore, authorities are directed to ensure the procedure of arrest as per the guidelines of Supreme Court enshrined in the case of Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273.
6.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
